incidence.definition: Share of men / of women who play (the report's headline is 67% of Americans ages 5-90 playing weekly, which includes children). Age-band rates aren't modeled in v1 — ESA reports the gender skew reverses for older cohorts (Boomer women 52% vs men 47%) — so the flat gender rate is applied across all ages.
